title: Michael Penix Jr. is ‘very close’ but says Falcons deserve 100% from him

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Michael Penix Jr. is ‘very close’ but says Falcons deserve 100% from him
sources.description: How long will Tua Tagovailoa hold onto the Falcons’ starting QB job? Time will tell, but Michael Penix says he’s getting closer to 100%.
